paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter from long-term frequency comparisons of optical and microwave atomic clocks
coupling_convention: d_me, dimensionless linear scalar coupling to electron mass, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 4(b); limits already rescaled by factor 3.0 for stochastic field amplitude
notes: Paper compares an 171Yb optical lattice clock with a 133Cs fountain clock over 298 days, setting new 95% CL limits on scalar DM couplings d_me (electron mass) and d_g (gluon/QCD) for m_phi = 1e-22 to 1e-20 eV, assuming rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 and including a stochastic-field rescaling factor of 3.0. The only explicit numerical limit in the text is d_me <~ 1.6e-6 at m_phi ~ 5e-22 eV (best point, improved by ~10^3). Other data points are reconstructed by scaling the roughly flat amplitude limit (white-noise regime) linearly with mass/frequency per Eq.(5); they are approximate since Fig.4 numerical values are not tabulated. The paper also constrains d_g (new in 1e-22 to 1e-21 eV), d_e, and d_mq, but d_me is the headline improved coupling per the abstract and pre-analysis hint.
